== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ルークのケープ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース使用して任意の反乱軍かエイリアンに配備する。そのキャラクターは耐：損耗＜3を得る。加えて、「ルークのケープ」がタトゥイーン以外の位置カード上に配備されているなら、毎ターン余分に1フォース起動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ルークがパイロットとしてこれから繰り広げる冒険と、迫り来る運命を象徴するかのようにはためくケープ。「おまえは今、新たな世界への一歩を踏み出したのだ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Luke's Cape.

'''Lore''' — Luke’s cape billows as if to symbolize his future adventures as a pilot and the destiny approaching him. “You have now taken a step into a new world.”

'''Game text''' — Use 2 Force to deploy on any Rebel or alien. That character gains immunity to attrition less than 3. If Luke’s Cape is deployed at a location card other than Tatooine, you may also activate one extra Force each turn.

The original English face uses “present at any non-Tatooine location.” The Japanese face describes Luke’s Cape as deployed at a location card other than Tatooine.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-lukescape-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Luke's Cape]].</ref>
